concepts.label: Neutrino detector
concepts.definition: The physics experiment Mira's group runs.

memories.text: Report every physical quantity in SI units, with a space between number and unit; convert before plotting.
Quote a measurement with its uncertainty to one significant figure (two if the leading digit is 1) and the same decimal places in the value.
In particle physics a discovery claim needs five sigma; three sigma counts only as evidence.
Calibrate the detector: warm up for 30 minutes, run the reference source, fit the gain, and enter it in the calibration log.

steps: warm up the electronics for 30 minutes
run the reference source for 10 minutes
record gain and temperature in the calibration log

memories.text: The calibration drifted with room temperature; log the temperature with every run.

fields.situation: gain values drift between calibration days
fields.insight: the electronics depend on room temperature
fields.do_instead: log the temperature with every run

memories.text: Subtract the background measured with the beam off, using the same live time as the signal run.
The detector response model is a Geant4 simulation, version 11.1.
The detector response model is a Geant4 simulation, version 11.2 since the September upgrade.
The elementary charge is exactly 1.602176634e-19 coulomb in the SI since 2019.
A factor-1000 error came from mixing MeV and GeV in one table; put the energy unit in every column header.

fields.insight: MeV and GeV were mixed in one table

memories.text: Fit counting histograms with a chi-square using Poisson errors; use an unbinned likelihood when bins hold fewer than 10 counts.
